title: Crosman Recalls Air Pistols Due to Explosion Hazard
summary: The air pistols can explode at high temperatures, propelling the pistol's broken plastic pieces into the air, and posing a risk of serious eye and other injuries to users. Units: About 16,000.

title: Target Recalls Threshold Floor Lamps Due to Fire and Shock Hazard
summary: The lamp can short when a standard one-way bulb is fully tightened in the lamp's three-way socket, posing a fire and shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 25,000 and 541 in Canada..

title: DENY Designs Recalls Magnet Boards Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The steel magnet board can separate from wood backing causing it to fall and posing an injury hazard. Units: 82.

title: Frigidaire Recalls Professional Blenders Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The blender's blade shaft assembly can break during use, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 14,000.

title: Shimano American Recalls Disc Brake Calipers Due to Collision Hazard
summary: The calipers on the disc brakes can fail, posing a collision hazard. Units: About 6,600 in U.S. and 704 in Canada.

title: The Land of Nod Recalls Bed Frames Due to Entrapment Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The openings in the headboard and footboard pose an entrapment hazard to young children. Units: About 1,500.

title: The Children's Place Recalls Footed Pajamas Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The footed pajamas fail to meet the federal flammability standard for children's sleepwear, posing a burn hazard to children. The garments are being recalled because they do not meet the tight-fitting sizing requirements. Units: About 38,000 in the United States and 3,280 in Canada.

title: Waterlogic Recalls Water Cooling, Heating Systems Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The hot water tank can stop functioning and cause the machine to overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 48,000.

title: Ceiling-Mounted Light Fixtures Recalled by Dolan Designs Due to Fire and Shock Hazards
summary: The fixture's socket wire insulation can degrade and lead to charged wires becoming exposed, causing electricity to pass to the metal canopy of the fixture. This poses a fire and electric shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 8,000.

title: Gree Recalls 12 Brands of Dehumidifiers Due to Serious Fire and Burn Hazards; More Than $2 Million in Property Damage Reported
summary: The dehumidifiers can overheat, smoke and catch fire, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 2.2 million in the United States and 52,500 in Canada.

title: Cambridge Metal & Plastics Recalls Motorcycle Training Wheels Due to a Crash Hazard
summary: Bolts and nuts securing the wheel can loosen and cause the rider to lose control, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 4,000.

title: Hachette Book Group Recalls Children's Books Due To Choking and Laceration Hazards
summary: A metal rod holding small beads on the cover of books can detach and release small parts that present a choking hazard. A detached metal bar can expose a sharp edge posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 70,000.

title: L.L.Bean Recalls Boat Carts for Canoes and Kayaks; Plastic Wheel Rims Can Burst and Injure Users
summary: The cart's plastic wheel rims can burst when the rubber tires are over-inflated, posing an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,200.

title: Visonic Recalls Amber Personal Emergency Response System Kits Due to Remote Pendant Battery Signal Failure
summary: A single Amber Base station set to Common Area Mode will not detect a low battery or dead battery warning signal from the remote pendant that notifies the end user or system administrator to replace the pendant battery. Units: About 24,000.

summary: The soft and colorful product can be mistaken by a child for candy. summary: The hard and colorful toy can be easily mistaken for candy by a child. title: Festool Recalls Plunge Cut Circular Saw Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The plunge lock can engage when not intended, causing the saw blade to remain exposed from the housing following completion of the plunge cut and posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 5,200 in the U.S. and 500 in Canada.

title: Toys R Us Recalls Journey Girl Travel Trunks Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The blue metal handle on the trunk can be sharp, presenting a laceration hazard to the user. Units: About 12,650.

title: Votive Candle Holders Sold at Cracker Barrel Old Country Store Recalled Due to Fire Hazard; Made by Mercuries Asia
summary: The decorative ant's arms, used to hold up the votive cup, can break. If this happens, a lit candle can tip over or fall out, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 7,900.
